svg.title: Snowy Peak layout
svg.text: SNOWY PEAK · Snowy Peak · 66x44 tiles · road 3 tiles wide
Lap 219 tiles = 28,032 px · about 33 s per lap · closest the road comes to itself: 8.0 tiles · bridge crossing at 63°
Dashed white = racing line. Pink = mid-lap checkpoint. Pale blue on the road = ice. Orange = boost pad.
Kerbs wherever the bend is tight. Map edge is a wall. One faint square = one 128 px tile.
